entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:17376
Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 41657 of 2023

Applicant :- Sameer
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Pati Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.  This is the second bail application of the applicant the first bail application of the present applicant was rejected on merit by this Court on 01.06.2023.

3. By means of the instant second bail application, applicant-Sameer is seeking bail in Case Crime No. 181 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 of IPC, and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Earch, District Jhansi during pendency of trial.
4. It has been contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is further submitted that the first bail application of the present applicant was rejected on merit by this Court on 01.06.2023 but subsequently when the trial started PW-1 mother of the prosecutrix and PW-2 prosecutrix herself turned hostile and did not support the prosecution story and PW-2-prosecutrix made categorical statements in favour of the present accused/applicant.

It is next submitted that since prosecutrix is the star witness and did not Sameer vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135490561/
1 corroborate the prosecution version and her mother PW-1-informant as well.

entities.text: Sameer vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that there is no need to confine the accused/applicant in jail and now there is no possibility on the part of the accused/applicant to make influence upon the material witnesses of this case.
It is lastly submitted that applicant has no criminal history to his credit and he is languishing in jail since 19.11.2022.
5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail.

It has been submitted that statement under section 161 Cr.P.C. of the victim of this case corroborated the prosecution version, but however, he could not dispute the aforesaid fact and it is has been submitted that during the prosecution herself she declared hostile and did not affirm the prosecution case at all.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, applicant has no criminal history to his credit and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant,Sameer involved in aforesaid case crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to the following conditions:-
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witness.

iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted and/ or the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required.
iv.
The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

Order Date :- 6.2.2025 Vikram  Sameer vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135490561/
